name: gnn-supply-chain-risk
description: AI-driven N-tier supply chain resilience using Graph Neural Networks on Snowflake. Identifies hidden Tier-2+ supplier dependencies and concentration risks using PyTorch Geometric GraphSAGE on GPU compute.
notes: GPU Compute Pool (GPU_NV_S) and External Access Integration required for GNN notebook execution. Comment out Sections 13-14 of setup.sql if SPCS or EAI is not available. After setup, run CALL SF_SOLUTIONS.GNN_SUPPLY_CHAIN_RISK.RUN_RISK_SCORING() (no SPCS required) or deploy the GNN notebook to populate RISK_SCORES, PREDICTED_LINKS, and BOTTLENECKS tables.
